detailed_descriptions.en: The world of dotAGE gets bigger! Trade Secrets adds new elders, mechanics, resources, buildings, events, and much more! Trading Places! Resources gain a new role in Trade Secrets . The Goldlings have discovered your village, and they are eager to trade their coins for your resources! Stockpile goods in warehouses, move them via roads, and trade them through markets. Then use your hard earned coins to trade even more! Born to ride! Pips have finally discovered a better way to get their work done, by riding horses and using other means of transports! Craft boats, build carts, and tame horses to aid in the expansion of your village! Brave new world! After years of fear, Pips are ready to explore the world beyond! Dispatch them on expeditions and see what they bring back: rare resources, lost blueprints… and the occasional unfamiliar disease. Three new elders! New elders join the world of dotAGE! Meet Wanna the Merchant; Darwin the Explorer, and the elusive Granny! ..and secrets? The outside world is mysterious, what might be waiting for you out there? Some Pips say that there is a lost treasure out there, as well as some kind of... special cult. There is only one way to find out... start exploring in Trade Secrets !
